caseName: United States v. Southwestern Cable Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. Southwestern Cable Co. and Midwest Television, Inc. v. Southwestern Cable Co.
attorneys: Arthur Scheiner and Harold F. Reis on the motion for Southwestern Cable Co. Solicitor General Griswold for the United States et al., and Ernest W. Jemes and Charles A. Miller for Midwest Television, Inc., et al. in opposition.

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Motion to vacate stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas and Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.

[For previous orders herein, see e. g., 389 U. S. 1029.]
